description: BUG-12: a token that names a path existing somewhere in the tree resolves - just not from the base reflock guessed - so calling it rot is a claim reflock cannot support. D4 is the precedent: wiki-links already fall back from relative resolution to a match across the index. D4 needs its match to be unique because it must pick one target to fingerprint; suspects picks nothing, so uniqueness is irrelevant here. A genuinely absent sibling in the same directory is still reported.
